approved_changes: After 事情开始变得有趣了, remove the exchange about accepting reflection; move directly into inventing the three-energy attack
Compress 一格能放波——那三格呢 to 那……三格气呢？ for a visual thought-to-fingers bridge
Use the existing authentic Japanese Hadouken recording, once across all alternating shots
Make R/AN alternate as matched phases of one action, not complete performances repeated separately
Accelerate each R/AN cut pair: 12,9,6,4,3 frames per shot, then merge original drawings with anime
Stop rock after hit, leave first reaction dry; resolve with a short same-theme guitar tag after last spoken word

auditions.direction: 十岁红头带中国男孩，刚刚笑着想到了新招式。恢复年轻男孩本音，用带着坏笑、压低而轻快的声音自言自语：那，三格气呢？那字是想到主意的短停顿，三格气三个字得意但清晰，尾音很有把握。像课间朋友面前的小聪明，不要播音，不要严肃解说，不要夸张大喊，不要音乐。
